findings.description: Pedro Pablo Chaves married Juana Flores on 30 August 1859 in Buenos Aires; she was the daughter of Sebastian Flores and Isabel Rivero.
supporting_sources: Argentina, Buenos Aires, registros parroquiales, 1635-2017 — entry for Pedro Chaves and Juana Flores, 30 Aug 1859, naming his parents Isidro Chaves and Andrea Guerra
